title: No single canonical authority layer across v0-v7
finding: Components, materials, features, screens, sources, and backlog items are split across version folders. A code harness can reasonably import multiple competing definitions without knowing which record is authoritative.
fix: Create stable canonical entity namespaces, a supersedes map, and a single root registry. New modules extend canonical IDs instead of creating parallel taxonomies.

title: Scale targets are mostly ingestion capacity, not completed factual datasets
finding: The 5,000 mosque, 10,000 supplier/product, 1,600 drawing, 550 video and country-regulatory targets are structured queues/shells, not verified records.
fix: Separate target_count, candidate_count, verified_count, reviewed_count and publishable_count. UI/docs must never call target slots 'ingested'.

title: Material cost catalog is structurally rich but largely unpriced
finding: Most 170 cost records explicitly have null local/import quotes. The platform cannot yet make production-grade regional cost claims.
fix: Add cost-data coverage metrics, quote ingestion pipeline, regional price books, freshness SLAs, and fallback hierarchy. Only deterministic placeholders can be used before verified quotes.

title: Regulatory packs are global shells, not verified jurisdiction packs
finding: 249 geographic shells were created, but launch-grade planning/building/fire/accessibility/tax/waqf rules require official-source research by country and subnational jurisdiction.
fix: Require launch-jurisdiction completeness score and qualified review. Default all other packs to research_required.

title: No executable Supabase schema/migrations or RLS policies
finding: A table inventory exists but not SQL migrations, indexes, foreign keys, triggers, storage policies, RPC functions, or RLS test fixtures.
fix: Generate migration plan, canonical table contracts, RLS role matrix and SQL test requirements before implementation can be called production-ready.

title: Offline behavior is mentioned but conflict resolution is underspecified
finding: Field reports, scans, inspections, photos, tasks and edits can be created offline, but there is no canonical outbox, idempotency, conflict or attachment retry protocol.
fix: Define local mutation envelope, client UUIDs, version numbers, last-write rules only for safe entities, conflict queue for high-value records, and deterministic attachment retry.

title: Three.js vision lacks a canonical geometric kernel contract
finding: Features exist for massing, floors, rooms, qibla and saff, but units, coordinate systems, snapping, topology, undo/redo, constraints, geometry versioning and validation rules are not defined.
fix: Add geometric kernel requirements and deterministic pure-function architecture separate from rendering.

title: Religious-review requirement exists but prayer/qibla methodology is incomplete
finding: The product distinguishes religious claims from architecture, but it does not yet define qibla geodesic calculation, prayer-time methods, Asr method, high-latitude handling, or mosque-published iqama provenance.
fix: Add a religious-calculation policy registry and treat calculated prayer times separately from congregation schedules.

title: Property discovery/listing ingestion lacks licensing and transaction workflow depth
finding: Paste listing/search concepts exist, but there is no canonical real-estate provider policy, listing freshness model, broker/contact workflow, offer/LOI state machine, financing contingency, closing checklist or appraisal workflow.
fix: Add property acquisition lifecycle and provider-rights abstraction.

title: Progress monitoring lacks a canonical schedule/cost baseline relationship
finding: Progress, schedule of values, activities and payment claims are modeled, but baseline revision rules and linkage among WBS/activity/cost code/model object are not canonical.
fix: Introduce Control Account / Work Package links and immutable baseline revisions.

title: No full operating calendar / recurring workload engine
finding: Maintenance, Ramadan and programs exist, but no unified recurrence/calendar engine covers daily opening, salah preparation, cleaning, inspections, classes, payroll, permits, warranties, Ramadan and annual governance.
fix: Add recurrence engine with iCal-compatible rules, owners, escalation and completion evidence.

title: Accounting integration and fund accounting are not yet complete
finding: Restricted funds and donations are modeled, but chart of accounts, journal mapping, bank reconciliation, fiscal year, accrual/cash accounting modes, vendor bills and financial statements are missing.
fix: Add accounting ledger boundary and integrations; mosque.build need not replace accounting software but must map transactions correctly.

title: Security controls exist but no formal threat model, incident response or RPO/RTO
finding: MFA/RLS/backups are referenced without explicit SLOs, recovery objectives, breach/incident workflow or threat inventory.
fix: Add threat model, security incident plan, RPO/RTO targets by data class, key rotation and disaster-recovery test cadence.

title: Exact UI copy is incomplete across the full route/state inventory
finding: Screen contracts exist, but most states contain structural slots rather than production copy.
fix: Create copy registry keyed by route/state/action/error with translation/review status.

title: Localization and RTL are largely absent
finding: A global mosque product requires language packs, locale-aware dates/numbers/currencies, Arabic RTL, local scripts, transliteration and units.
fix: Add i18n/RTL architecture and translation review workflow.

title: Search and ranking are not fully specified
finding: Directory/search exists, but ranking signals, typo handling, aliases, multilingual search, geospatial radius, closed locations, duplicate handling and source trust are not canonical.
fix: Add search index document schema and ranking policy.

title: No canonical notification preference and escalation system
finding: Push/email/SMS are mentioned but not unified across permit deadlines, overdue RFIs, donations, maintenance, prayer/program announcements and Ramadan.
fix: Add event-to-notification policy, user preferences, quiet hours, severity and dedupe.

title: Commercial entitlement model is missing
finding: Business models are listed but no plan/entitlement architecture exists for public users, projects, mosque operations, professionals or enterprise portfolios.
fix: Add entitlement matrix independent of payment provider.

title: SEO route design is strong but content-quality gates need stronger canonicalization
finding: Programmatic routes exist; thin-page guardrails exist, but no per-page minimum evidence/content score or duplicate-content fingerprint.
fix: Add indexability scoring and canonical entity selection.

title: Accessibility is a major product domain but app accessibility targets are generic
finding: Building accessibility is detailed, while digital accessibility lacks explicit conformance target, focus order, screen reader labels, reduced motion, 3D alternatives and non-visual plan access.
fix: Add WCAG-oriented digital acceptance criteria and accessible alternatives for visual tools.

title: Canonical domain formatting is inconsistent
finding: Some manifests use 'mosque.build'; others use 'https://mosque.build'.
fix: Canonical origin = https://mosque.build; canonical brand/domain token = mosque.build.

title: Life status and biographical seeds contain explicit 'verify' placeholders
finding: The seed correctly marks uncertainty, but any public profile generator must exclude these fields until reviewed.
fix: Add publishability gate for people authority records.

title: Source freshness and availability are not continuously monitored
finding: Source registries store URLs/verification dates but no automated broken-link/supersession monitor exists.
fix: Add scheduled source-health checks, checksum/snapshot metadata where allowed, and superseded-source relationships.

title: Analytics events exist only at a coarse level
finding: There is no canonical event naming/versioning/privacy schema across 3D edits, cost comparisons, property analysis, donations and operations.
fix: Add analytics dictionary and prohibit raw sensitive values in analytics payloads.

title: Suggestion engine lacks explicit explainability and authority boundaries
finding: Suggestions are powerful but need to distinguish deterministic calculations, heuristic recommendations and any future AI-generated narrative.
fix: Each suggestion must declare engine_type, inputs, sources, confidence, impacts, and whether professional review is required.
